subject: dsa
title: Search a 2D Matrix
summary: Each row is sorted and every row's first value beats the previous row's last, so the matrix is one sorted list. Binary-search it.
problem: Given an m by n matrix where each row is sorted and the first integer of each row is greater than the last of the previous row, decide whether a target value is present.

steps.caption: Goal: find 16. The matrix is fully sorted, so treat it as one sorted list of 12 and binary-search.
lo=0, hi=11, mid=5 maps to cell (1,1)=11. 11 is less than 16, so search the right half.
lo=6, hi=11, mid=8 maps to cell (2,0)=23. 23 is greater than 16, so search the left half.
lo=6, hi=7, mid=6 maps to cell (1,2)=16. Found it.
Done. Target 16 is in the matrix, so the answer is true.
